name: Nest Treasury Vault
oneLiner: nTBILL is Nest's NAV-accreting Treasury vault token, routing into Janus Henderson JTRSY and Superstate USTB short-duration T-bill exposure.
collateral: Tokenised short-duration U.S. Treasury exposure routed by Nest into Janus Henderson JTRSY and Superstate USTB positions, plus a small stablecoin liquidity buffer
pegMechanism: Vault LP token whose value targets a dollar base and accretes through underlying Treasury fund NAV; primary mint and redemption occur through Nest at vault NAV against USDC and pUSD

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Nest materials identify nTBILL as a Treasury-bill fund-share exposure, but the reviewed sources do not provide the current compiler-required assurance, reconciliation, custody continuity, seniority, liquidity, valuation, or loss-recovery inputs for a complete mechanism review.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Nest retains issuer / admin authority over vault shares with permissioned issuance and freeze surfaces beyond reserve-only exposure.

notices.title: NAV-style dollar asset
notices.message: nTBILL is a Nest vault share whose value tracks the underlying Treasury fund book. It behaves like a vault share rather than a hard 1:1 par stablecoin.

mintAuthority.summary: nTBILL is a Nest vault share on the Nucleus/BoringVault architecture; the permissioned Teller mints/burns shares when users deposit pUSD at vault NAV, while the Nest-controlled Manager directs Treasury-fund allocation. Both Teller and Manager are owned by a Nest 3-of-6 Safe.

controls.label: Nest Treasury Vault Teller (issuance/redemption)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096, owner() on the Teller returned 0xa08A0Dc480BD60d1d56C8EeC6c722125eAfEa982, confirmed as a 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe (v1.3.0+L2) via Safe API. In the Nest/Nucleus BoringVault model the Teller is the only contract that mints and burns vault receipt tokens.

controls.label: Nest Treasury Vault Manager (strategy/admin)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096, owner() on the Manager returned 0xa08A0Dc480BD60d1d56C8EeC6c722125eAfEa982, the same 3-of-6 Safe that owns the Teller. The Manager governs vault strategy and sits in the admin path over BoringVault/Teller issuance.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096, owner() on both Teller and Manager returned 0xa08A0Dc480BD60d1d56C8EeC6c722125eAfEa982. Safe API confirmed: 3-of-6 threshold, version 1.3.0+L2, no modules, no guard.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096: owner() on Teller (0x1492062b) and Manager (0xf713a353) both returned 0xa08A0Dc480BD60d1d56C8EeC6c722125eAfEa982. Safe API confirmed 3-of-6 Safe, version 1.3.0+L2, modules [], guard zero. All mint-capable surfaces confirmed. Evidence challenge completed 2026-07-15: Nest publishes issuer-operated hourly NAV and live vault composition, with the latest public vault-data snapshot dated 2026-07-08, but no recurring independent reconciliation of nTBILL supply to portfolio assets was found. Regulation of underlying Treasury products does not prudentially supervise the Nest wrapper issuer. Upgrade-authority follow-up (2026-07-21): the nTBILL token at 0xe72fe64840f4ef80e3ec73a1c749491b5c938cb9 is the exact_match-verified Nucleus BoringVault.sol implementation itself, not a proxy — the EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon storage slots all read zero at Ethereum block 25579998, and its Sourcify ABI has no upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall entry point. owner() reads the Nest admin contract 0x8fAACdC65de5D78975dF4f9DC4B6548979cEb23A (matching this asset's bridgeRouteRisk finding) and authority() reads 0x0A4F939b5D51157c58bA053275Eaf77a782B4996; these control BoringVault administrative parameters (setAuthority, transferOwnership, setBeforeTransferHook) but cannot swap the vault's deployed bytecode, so mint-critical logic itself is immutable rather than upgradeable.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: nTBILL is an issuer-native Nest BoringVault share deployed at the identical CREATE2 address 0xe72fe64840f4ef80e3ec73a1c749491b5c938cb9 on Ethereum, Plume, and Arbitrum. Row-level on-chain verification on 2026-07-20: Ethereum and Plume owner() both return the Nest admin contract 0x8faacdc65de5d78975df4f9dc4b6548979ceb23a (the same uniform owner seen on the reviewed nWISDOM deployments), and Arbitrum owner() returns the Nest 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 that also owns the nTBILL Teller and Manager on Ethereum. Shares mint only through Nest's own Teller at vault NAV; no third-party bridge mints any deployment.
